     3	/-!
     4	# Rounded Horner evaluation
     5	
     6	Coefficients are listed in increasing degree order. The error envelope uses
     7	only exact evaluation and the relative-error parameter; it is independent of
     8	the rounding operation. The final proof is left to the proof role.
     9	-/
    10	
    11	namespace Research.Horner
    12	
    13	/-- Exact Horner evaluation, with coefficients in increasing degree order. -/
    14	def P : List ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
    15	  | [], _ => 0
    16	  | a :: tail, x => a + x * P tail x
    17	
    18	/-- Horner evaluation with one rounded multiplication and one rounded addition
    19	at each list step. -/
    20	def Q (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model) : List ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
    21	  | [], _ => 0
    22	  | a :: tail, x => model.round (a + model.round (x * Q model tail x))
    23	
    24	/-- The prescribed forward-error envelope, computed entirely from exact data. -/
    25	def E : List ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
    26	  | [], _, _ => 0
    27	  | a :: tail, x, u =>
    28	      let v := P tail x
    29	      let e := E tail x u
    30	      u * |a + x * v| + (1 + u) * (u * |x * v| + (1 + u) * |x| * e)
    31	
    32	@[simp] theorem P_nil (x : ℝ) : P [] x = 0 := rfl
    33	
    34	@[simp] theorem P_cons (a : ℝ) (tail : List ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    35	    P (a :: tail) x = a + x * P tail x := rfl
    36	
    37	@[simp] theorem Q_nil (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model) (x : ℝ) :
    38	    Q model [] x = 0 := rfl
    39	
    40	@[simp] theorem Q_cons (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model)
    41	    (a : ℝ) (tail : List ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    42	    Q model (a :: tail) x = model.round (a + model.round (x * Q model tail x)) := rfl
    43	
    44	@[simp] theorem E_nil (x u : ℝ) : E [] x u = 0 := rfl
    45	
    46	@[simp] theorem E_cons (a : ℝ) (tail : List ℝ) (x u : ℝ) :
    47	    E (a :: tail) x u =
    48	      u * |a + x * P tail x| +
    49	        (1 + u) * (u * |x * P tail x| + (1 + u) * |x| * E tail x u) := rfl
    50	
    51	/-- Absolute error of a single rounding. -/
    52	lemma round_error (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model) (z : ℝ) :
    53	    |model.round z - z| ≤ model.u * |z| := by
    54	  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hr⟩ := model.round_spec z
    55	  rw [hr]
    56	  calc
    57	    |z * (1 + δ) - z| = |z| * |δ| := by
    58	      rw [show z * (1 + δ) - z = z * δ by ring, abs_mul]
    59	    _ ≤ |z| * model.u := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ (abs_nonneg z)
    60	    _ = model.u * |z| := mul_comm _ _
    61	
    62	/-- Error relative to an arbitrary reference value. -/
    63	lemma round_perturbation (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model) (z t : ℝ) :
    64	    |model.round z - t| ≤ model.u * |t| + (1 + model.u) * |z - t| := by
    65	  have hz : |z| ≤ |t| + |z - t| := by
    66	    calc
    67	      |z| = |t + (z - t)| := by congr 1; ring
    68	      _ ≤ |t| + |z - t| := abs_add_le _ _
    69	  calc
    70	    |model.round z - t| = |(model.round z - z) + (z - t)| := by
    71	      congr 1; ring
    72	    _ ≤ |model.round z - z| + |z - t| := abs_add_le _ _
    73	    _ ≤ model.u * |z| + |z - t| := add_le_add (round_error model z) (le_refl _)
    74	    _ ≤ model.u * (|t| + |z - t|) + |z - t| :=
    75	      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz model.u_nonneg) (le_refl _)
    76	    _ = model.u * |t| + (1 + model.u) * |z - t| := by ring
    77	
    78	/-- Universal forward-error bound in the supplied relative-error model.
    79	The only rounding assumptions are the fields of `model`: nonnegativity of
    80	`model.u` and its existential relative-error law. No restrictions are imposed
    81	on the coefficient list, the real input, or the size of `model.u`.
    82	-/
    83	theorem forward_error_bound (model : Research.FloatingPoint.Model)
    84	    (coefficients : List ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    85	    |Q model coefficients x - P coefficients x| ≤ E coefficients x model.u := by
    86	  have hu : 0 ≤ 1 + model.u := by linarith [model.u_nonneg]
    87	  induction coefficients with
    88	  | nil => simp
    89	  | cons a tail ih =>
    90	    have hm : |model.round (x * Q model tail x) - x * P tail x| ≤
    91	        model.u * |x * P tail x| +
    92	          (1 + model.u) * |x| * E tail x model.u := by
    93	      calc
    94	        _ ≤ model.u * |x * P tail x| +
    95	            (1 + model.u) * |x * Q model tail x - x * P tail x| :=
    96	          round_perturbation model _ _
    97	        _ = model.u * |x * P tail x| +
    98	            (1 + model.u) * |x| * |Q model tail x - P tail x| := by
    99	          rw [← mul_sub x (Q model tail x) (P tail x), abs_mul x (Q model tail x - P tail x)]
   100	          ring
   101	        _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (le_refl _)
   102	          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (mul_nonneg hu (abs_nonneg x)))
   103	    simp only [Q_cons, P_cons, E_cons]
   104	    calc
   105	      _ ≤ model.u * |a + x * P tail x| +
   106	          (1 + model.u) * |(a + model.round (x * Q model tail x)) -
   107	            (a + x * P tail x)| := round_perturbation model _ _
   108	      _ = model.u * |a + x * P tail x| +
   109	          (1 + model.u) * |model.round (x * Q model tail x) - x * P tail x| := by
   110	        rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]
   111	      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (le_refl _) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hm hu)
   112	
   113	end Research.Horner

     4	# Abstract floating-point model
     5	
     6	This is the standard relative-error model used by the binary-tree project,
     7	not a bit-level formalization of IEEE 754.

    10	namespace Research.FloatingPoint
    11	
    12	/-- A rounding operation satisfying the standard relative-error model.
    13	The specification covers operations for which overflow and underflow do not occur.
    14	-/
    15	structure Model where
    16	  u : ℝ
    17	  u_nonneg : 0 ≤ u
    18	  round : ℝ → ℝ
    19	  round_spec : ∀ z : ℝ, ∃ δ : ℝ, |δ| ≤ u ∧ round z = z * (1 + δ)
    20	
    21	/-- Floating-point addition induced by an abstract rounding model. -/
    22	def Model.add (model : Model) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    23	  model.round (a + b)
    24	
    25	/-- Floating-point multiplication induced by an abstract rounding model. -/
    26	def Model.mul (model : Model) (a b : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    27	  model.round (a * b)
    28	
    29	end Research.FloatingPoint
